verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several APIs (Alerts, Case, Case Import, filing), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is a help-center index, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
